case.note: UPI scam via fake customer care. Money debited today.
case.story: Today I searched for my bank's customer care number on Google and called a number. The person asked me to install an app and then Rs 45000 was debited from my account in 10 minutes. I think it was a scam.
case.extra: It happened about 1 hour ago. I paid with UPI from my savings account. I did not tell anyone my PIN but I installed the screen sharing app.
case.proofs: I have the bank SMS alerts, the number I called and the call log. I have not told the bank yet.

analysis.plain_explanation: You have faced a serious online financial fraud where money was illegally debited from your bank account through a UPI transaction after you installed a screen-sharing app. You should immediately report this financial fraud on the national cyber crime portal or helpline to try to block the transaction before the money is moved. You also need to inform your bank right away so they can freeze your account and protect you from further losses. Please note that since you installed a screen-sharing app, recovering money depends heavily on how fast you report it and the actions taken by the bank and cyber authorities.

steps.title: Call the National Cyber Crime Helpline immediately
steps.detail: Call the 24x7 toll-free helpline number 1930 or visit cybercrime.gov.in to report the financial fraud right away so that authorities can try to freeze the transaction before the money is transferred further.
steps.where: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal / helpline 1930

steps.title: Inform your bank immediately to block account and report fraud
steps.detail: Contact your bank's official customer care or visit your branch right away to report the unauthorised transaction, block your debit card, UPI handles, and freeze your account to prevent further losses.
steps.where: Your bank's official customer care helpline or nearest branch

steps.title: Submit a written complaint to your bank
steps.detail: Submit a formal written complaint to your bank detailing the unauthorised UPI transaction, attaching the SMS alerts, call logs, and the cyber crime acknowledgment copy once obtained.
steps.where: Bank branch manager or official bank grievance email

steps.title: Lodge an online cyber crime complaint
steps.detail: Register a detailed complaint on the cybercrime.gov.in portal, providing all transaction details, the fake number called, and the screen-sharing app name to get an official complaint reference number.

steps.title: (General) Approach the RBI Ombudsman if the bank fails to resolve
steps.detail: If your bank does not resolve your complaint or reply within the prescribed time after you have reported the unauthorised transaction, you can file a complaint online on the RBI Ombudsman portal.
steps.where: RBI Integrated Ombudsman portal at cms.rbi.org.in

plan.forum: National Cyber Crime Portal / Helpline 1930 and your Bank / RBI Ombudsman
plan.summary: You have faced a serious online financial fraud where Rs 45000 was debited via UPI after calling a fake customer care number and installing a screen-sharing app. You must immediately call 1930, report the fraud on cybercrime.gov.in, and inform your bank to freeze your account and dispute the transaction.

reasons: Scam and fraud cases need police and bank action that this tool can only guide you to. Get a lawyer if the police or bank refuse to act.
